title: 第13章 秘境中的秘境第14章 真正的神品御剑术
content_zh:
杨修拖着精疲力尽的身体在主路上攀爬着就在他感觉浑身力气快要枯竭的时候，一座门关再次出现在他眼前，杨修用手用力拍了下意识发昏的脑袋，再次加快了速度。
在杨修跨过门关的那一刻体内的灵气瞬间恢复，而他身上关节的酸痛和爬山带来的饥饿以及那种缺水状态瞬间消失了，他震惊的看着那个门关可是当他向下望去的时候发现他进入的第一个门关居然在这座门关的不远处，看样子他只走了很小一段的距离，杨修立刻用灵识感应，果然那段路有很多的空间折叠自己感觉走了很远的路实际上也就是一小段。
“如果不是来到这里我真的没办法想象空间裂隙可以密集到这种程度！还有这个神奇的门关这治愈能力也太强了吧！”杨修内心嘀咕着视线也转移到了接下来的路上，与刚进来时想马上出去的思绪不同，现在他更想做的是探索这里。
接下来的路没有了门关而是一道空间裂隙明晃晃的摆在大路中间，杨修放开灵识再次感知发现四周的空间也是被锁定的走不了野路，便坚定的走向了空间裂隙。
走进空间裂隙一瞬间场景变了，他从原来的山路上来到了一片巨大的湖泊边，而在他脚边出现了一个小箱子，杨修愣了一下，让他愣的不是箱子而是在这剑山秘境内部居然还有秘境中的秘境，刚才身处的是山，而现在他的灵识告诉他这地方没有山方圆数里都是平原。
杨修弯腰拿起小箱子打开，箱子内闪过一道光而箱内的东西是极品灵石，极品灵石在大乾王朝十分稀少，具体多稀少杨修不知道只是这东西他在杨府没见过唯一一次见到是他五岁时父亲因为打了胜仗立功，皇帝大喜摆了宴席特意宴请众将军以及其亲属而在宴会皇帝将自己宝贵的极品灵石给众人观赏过，那时皇帝手中灵石散发出的气息以及霞光和这箱内的灵石一模一样。
杨修挥手将灵石收入戒指中，嘴里嘀咕道“这是给闯关成功的人奖励吗？”
“哗啦！”杨修刚将灵石收进去原本平静的湖泊出现了一道环绕着雾气的身影，最开始杨修看不清到底是什么东西，但是当雾气散开之后，身影的真容出现在杨修眼前，只见一只墨色巨龟俯首盯着杨修，而在他身上还缠绕着一只巨蛇与巨龟不一样的是巨蛇脑袋惬意的趴在巨龟的龟壳上眼睛紧闭着看样子是在睡觉，两者身上散发出的威压让杨修呼吸有点不顺畅起来，显然这是来自神兽的威压。
“这秘境几百年没来人了，这次来的居然只是这么弱的人类小娃娃吗？”巨龟口吐人言道。
虽然巨龟只是正常说话但是在杨修耳中确实非常巨大为了避免耳膜被震破，杨修运转灵气在耳朵上凝聚力一道灵气墙用来减弱音量，看着巨龟虽然心里猜测到其身份但杨修还是深深鞠了一躬开口道“请问您是？”
谁知巨龟大笑了一声开口道“小子好没见识还是说我的样貌已经被遗忘了吗？吾乃神兽玄武！”
杨修听到玄武的回答心中虽然有答案但是还是很惊讶，他稳了稳心神开口道“小子自然是知道神兽玄武之名，只是没想过能在这里见到！”
“小子我问你，你是怎么来到此处的？”听到杨修的话之后玄武威严的声音再次开口。
玄武的话让杨修有点摸不着头脑便开口问道“前辈这里不是剑山秘境中的秘境吗？”
杨修的话让玄武陷入了一秒的沉默随后只听玄武嘀咕着“原来是剑山秘境吗？这么说那东西苏醒了？”
玄武的话让杨修更加懵逼了，但是杨修还没开口问便听到玄武说“小子你如果说这是剑山秘境中的秘境倒也没错，但是这里并不只是属于剑山秘境！你是怎么进入剑山秘境的？”
杨修听到玄武的问题开口道“偶然进入！”
玄武听了杨修的话笑了一声说了一句“不是偶然！”
这句话让杨修内心好奇心大盛问道“前辈为何说不是偶然？”
玄武盯着杨修没有开口，意思很明确它不想说。

杨修被看的有点尴尬知道玄武不想回答这个问题便又开口道“前辈知道怎么出去吗？”
“知道！击败我就可以出去！”这次玄武开口了但是说的话让杨修内心大震。
杨修尴尬一笑开口道“前莫不是与小子说笑吧，您的实力动动手就能捏死小子！”
玄武听到杨修的话转头看了看趴在他背上的白色巨蛇开口道“确实！虽然我是一缕神魂但是确是证道实力动动手确实能捏死你，再说我的老伙计似乎对你也很不感兴趣！”
神魂就有证道境？那本体岂不是更强？杨修听到玄武的话内心先是震惊紧接着松了一口气，然后一脸笑意的看着玄武问道“那前辈让晚辈直接离去？”
本以为玄武不出手会让自己离去的杨修听到玄武说“直接让你离去就失去了这座秘境存在的意义了，既然我证道境不能出手就这样！”
话落只见在玄武身侧的湖泊中又走出一个身影，是一只鳄鱼，这鳄鱼在阳光的照耀下通体金黄色，爪子只是看去便锋利无比，满口的獠牙也露在外面，看的杨修一惊。
这章没有结束，请点击下一页继续阅读！
玄武看着黄金鳄鱼比较满意的点点头，随后对杨修说道“这秘境存在的意义就是考验你们进入这里的人，这就是这里的规则，虽然境界高的我不能出手，但是这只鳄鱼可以做你的对手，它只有问道二阶一重实力对你来讲击败他应该不难吧！”
杨修玄武的话开口说“前辈我才问道一阶九重！”
谁知杨修还没说完便被玄武打断，只听玄武说“我知道！进入这里的都是天骄，身为天骄肯定可以越级战斗，不要再多言了！”
玄武的话说完便后退一下，身旁的黄金鳄鱼向杨修冲了过来，杨修意念一动龙血剑出现在他的手中，看着冲过来的黄金鳄鱼杨修挥剑砍在鳄鱼头上，只听“铛”的一声原本连重剑都能洞穿龙血剑斩在鳄鱼头上被其表皮轻易抵挡了下来，鳄鱼表皮甚至一道伤痕都没留下来，反倒是杨修被鳄鱼的冲击力弄的后退数步。
“忘记告诉你了，这只鳄鱼有神鳄血脉，防御力非常强，小子要加油！”玄武对着杨修道，眼神中还带着幸灾乐祸的笑意。
杨修听到玄武的话心中暗叹，就知道没这么简单，这时鳄鱼又杀了过来，杨修赶忙应对，边应对边想着怎么击败这只鳄鱼。
“虽然身躯硬，但是总不能每个地方都这么硬吧！”杨修手中剑没停，大脑也飞速思考着，就在这时一直用头颅和尖牙攻击杨修的鳄鱼突然间甩动尾巴，杨修来不及防御结结实实挨了一下，被击飞出去倒在地上口中已经有了鲜血的味道。
虽然杨修的受伤了但是大脑也想到了解决方案，“他的身体在鳄鱼眼里都是弱点，鳄鱼表皮的防御力自己又没办法击破，那只有一处可以进攻那就是和人类一样脆弱的鳄鱼的眼睛！”

content_en:
Yang Xiu dragged his exhausted body up the main road. Just when he felt that all his strength was about to run out, a gate appeared in front of him again. Yang Xiu patted his unconscious head hard with his hand and speeded up again.
The moment Yang Xiu crossed the gate, the spiritual energy in his body recovered instantly, and the pain in his joints, the hunger caused by climbing, and the lack of water disappeared instantly. He looked at the gate in shock. But when he looked down, he found that the first gate he entered was not far from this gate. It seemed that he had only walked a short distance.
"If I hadn't come here, I really wouldn't have imagined that the spatial rifts could be so dense! And the healing power of this magical door is too strong!" Yang Xiu muttered in his heart and shifted his attention to the road ahead. Unlike when he first came in, he wanted to get out immediately. What he wanted to do now was to explore this place.
There was no gate on the next road but a space crack was placed in the middle of the road. Yang Xiu let go of his spiritual sense and sensed again and found that the surrounding space was also locked and he could not walk wildly, so he walked firmly towards the space crack.
The moment he walked into the space rift, the scene changed. He came from the original mountain road to a huge lake, and a small box appeared at his feet. Yang Xiu was stunned for a moment. What surprised him was not the box but the fact that there was a secret realm within the secret realm inside the Sword Mountain Secret Realm. He was in a mountain just now, but now his spiritual consciousness told him that there were no mountains in this place and there were plains for miles around.
Yang Xiu bent down and picked up the small box and opened it. A light flashed inside the box, and the thing inside the box was a top-grade spiritual stone. Top-grade spiritual stones were very rare in the Daqian Dynasty. How rare they were. Yang Xiu didn't know, but he had never seen this thing in the Yang Mansion. The only time he saw it was with his father when he was five years old. Because of his victory and meritorious service, the emperor was overjoyed and held a banquet to entertain all the generals and their relatives. At the banquet, the emperor showed his precious spiritual stone to everyone. At that time, the aura and glow emanating from the spiritual stone in the emperor's hand were exactly the same as the spiritual stone in this box.
Yang Xiu waved his hand and put the spirit stone into the ring, muttering, "Is this a reward for those who successfully break through the level?"
"Wow!" Yang Xiu just put the spirit stone into the originally calm lake, and a figure surrounded by fog appeared. At first, Yang Xiu couldn't see what it was, but when the fog dispersed, the true appearance of the figure appeared in front of Yang Xiu's eyes, and he saw a giant ink-colored turtle lowering its head and staring at it. Yang Xiu, and there was a giant snake wrapped around him. The difference between the giant snake and the giant turtle was that the giant snake's head was lying comfortably on the giant turtle's shell. It looked like he was sleeping with his eyes closed. The pressure emanating from the two bodies made Yang Xiu's breathing a little difficult. It was obviously the pressure from the divine beast.
"No one has come to this secret realm for hundreds of years. Is it just such a weak human being who comes this time?" The giant turtle said.
Although the giant turtle only spoke normally, it was indeed very huge in Yang Xiu's ears. In order to prevent his eardrums from being shattered, Yang Xiu used his aura to gather a wall of aura on his ears to weaken the volume. Looking at the giant turtle, although he guessed its identity in his heart, Yang Xiu still bowed deeply and said, "Who are you?"
Unexpectedly, the giant turtle laughed loudly and said, "You are so ignorant, do you think my appearance has been forgotten? I am the mythical beast Xuanwu!"
When Yang Xiu heard Xuanwu's answer, although he knew the answer, he was still surprised. He calmed down and said, "Of course you know the name of the mythical beast Xuanwu, but you just didn't expect to see it here!"
"Boy, let me ask you, how did you get here?" After hearing Yang Xiu's words, Xuanwu's majestic voice spoke again.
Xuanwu's words made Yang Xiu a little confused and asked, "Senior, this is not Jianshan."A secret within a secret? "
Yang Xiu's words made Xuanwu fall into silence for a second, and then he only heard Xuanwu muttering, "Is it the secret realm of Jianshan? So that thing is awake? "
Xuanwu's words made Yang Xiu even more confused, but before Yang Xiu could ask, he heard Xuanwu say, "Boy, you are right if you say this is a secret realm in the Jianshan Secret Realm, but this is not just a secret realm in the Jianshan Mountain! How did you enter the secret realm of Jianshan? "
Yang Xiu heard Xuanwu's question and said, "Enter by accident! "
Xuanwu laughed after hearing Yang Xiu's words and said, "It's not an accident! "
This sentence aroused Yang Xiu's inner curiosity and asked, "Why did senior say it was not an accident?" "
Xuanwu stared at Yang Xiu without saying anything, his intention was very clear that he didn't want to say anything.
Yang Xiu looked a little embarrassed. Knowing that Xuanwu didn't want to answer this question, he spoke again, "Senior, do you know how to get out? "
"Know! Defeat me and you can get out! "This time Xuanwu spoke, but what he said shocked Yang Xiu's heart.
Yang Xiu smiled awkwardly and said, "Why don't you joke with the kid? You are so powerful that you can crush the kid to death with just your hands!" "
After hearing Yang Xiu's words, Xuanwu turned to look at the giant white snake lying on his back and said, "Indeed! Although I am a ray of soul, I do have the power to prove the truth. I can really crush you to death with my hands. Besides, my old friend seems to be very uninterested in you! "
Does the soul have the realm of enlightenment? Wouldn't the original body be stronger? When Yang Xiu heard Xuanwu's words, he was shocked at first and then breathed a sigh of relief. Then he looked at Xuanwu with a smile and asked, "Then the senior asked the junior to leave directly?" "
Yang Xiu, who originally thought that Xuanwu would let him go if he didn't take action, heard Xuanwu say, "If you leave directly, you will lose the meaning of the existence of this secret realm. Since I can't take action in the Taoist Realm, that's it!" "
As he finished speaking, he saw another figure walking out of the lake beside Xuanwu. It was a crocodile. This crocodile was golden in color under the sunlight. Its claws were extremely sharp just by looking at it. Its fangs were also exposed, which surprised Yang Xiu.

Xuanwu looked at the golden crocodile and nodded with satisfaction, and then said to Yang Xiu, "The purpose of this secret realm is to test those of you who enter here. These are the rules here. Although I can't take action because of my high level, this crocodile can be your opponent. It only has the strength of the second level and the first level. It shouldn't be difficult for you to defeat him!" "
Yang Xiu Xuanwu said, "Senior, I just asked about the first level and ninth level! "
Unexpectedly, Yang Xiu was interrupted by Xuanwu before he finished speaking, and Xuanwu said, "I know! Everyone who enters here is a genius. As a genius, you can definitely fight beyond the level. Don’t say any more! "
After Xuanwu finished speaking, he stepped back. The golden crocodile beside him rushed towards Yang Xiu. Yang Xiu thought and the Dragon Blood Sword appeared in his hand. Looking at the golden crocodile that rushed towards him, Yang Xiu slashed the crocodile's head with his sword. He heard a "clang" sound. Even the epee could have penetrated the dragon blood sword and slashed at the crocodile's head, but it was easily blocked by its skin. Not even a scar was left on the crocodile's skin. Instead, Yang Xiu was pushed back a few steps by the impact of the crocodile.
"I forgot to tell you, this crocodile has the blood of a divine crocodile and has very strong defense. Come on, boy! Xuanwu faced Yang Xiudao with a gloating smile in his eyes.
Yang Xiu sighed secretly when he heard Xuanwu's words, knowing that it was not that simple. At this time, the crocodile came to kill again. Yang Xiu hurriedly responded, thinking about how to defeat the crocodile while dealing with it.
“Although my body is hard, it can’t be so hard everywhere! "Yang Xiu didn't stop holding the sword in his hand, and his brain was thinking rapidly. At this moment, the crocodile that had been attacking Yang Xiu with its head and fangs suddenly swung its tail. Yang Xiu had no time to defend himself and was hit hard. He was knocked away and fell to the ground, with the taste of blood already in his mouth.
Although Yang Xiu was injured, his brain also thought of a solution, "HeThe body of the crocodile is a weak point in the eyes of the crocodile, and the defense of the crocodile's skin cannot be broken by itself. There is only one place where it can be attacked, and that is the crocodile's eyes, which are as fragile as humans! "
